verdict.rationale: Extend's docs clearly show per-field confidence scores on extraction runs. The confidence-scores page says to trust high-confidence values and route the rest to human review, but the pack never shows a first-party review queue or UI, nor any evidence that the scores are calibrated. missing for 10: evidence of calibration methodology, a documented built-in human review interface/queue for low-confidence fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields
